Combined accountability + security (audit-log processing as controller)

Technical documentation retention 10 years after placement on market
Timely security updates for Critical Class products

Severe incidents impacting product security — 24h/72h/1 month

Secure deletion / transfer of data on disposal or transfer
Policies on risk analysis and information system security
Human resources security, awareness and training
Management board training on cyber risk
Secure coding practices and CI/CD security
Early warning to CSIRT — 24h without undue delay
Technical/methodological specifications supplementing Art. 21(2) for specific sectors
Prohibited AI practices (negative analysis — no prohibited practice applies to GuardianGate)
Risk management system throughout AI system lifecycle
Risk management — identify and analyse known and reasonably foreseeable risks
Estimate and evaluate risks emerging after development
Adopt risk management measures across lifecycle (testing, post-market)
Training data governance — quality and relevance
Information for deployers and downstream providers
Enabling human oversight during use period
Resistance to adversarial attacks and unauthorised manipulation
Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment (FRIA) for high-risk AI in public services / border control
Conformity assessment — internal control (Annex VI) for most high-risk

attrs.description: Data protection by design and by default
Security of processing — technical and organisational measures
Adherence to approved codes of conduct / certification (processor)
Restore availability and access in a timely manner (backup/recovery)
Breach notification to supervisory authority within 72h
Breach notification by processor to controller without undue delay
Communication of breach to data subject when high risk
DPIA when high risk to data subjects
DPIA mandatory for large-scale Art. 9 processing (biometric)
DPO designation for large-scale Art. 9 processing (controller AND processor)
Combined accountability + security (audit-log processing as controller)
Secure by design — properties of the product
Security update retention 10 years or support period (whichever longer)
Technical documentation retention 10 years after placement on market
Timely security updates for Critical Class products
Actively exploited vulnerabilities — 24h early warning to CSIRT/ENISA, 72h notification, 14d final report
Severe incidents impacting product security — 24h/72h/1 month
Critical Class conformity — full quality assurance + EU-type examination by notified body (Art. 32(3) where no scheme)
Secure deletion / transfer of data on disposal or transfer
Policies on risk analysis and information system security
Human resources security, awareness and training
Management board training on cyber risk
Secure coding practices and CI/CD security
Early warning to CSIRT — 24h without undue delay
Technical/methodological specifications supplementing Art. 21(2) for specific sectors
Prohibited AI practices (negative analysis — no prohibited practice applies to GuardianGate)
Risk management system throughout AI system lifecycle
Risk management — identify and analyse known and reasonably foreseeable risks
Estimate and evaluate risks emerging after development
Adopt risk management measures across lifecycle (testing, post-market)
Training data governance — quality and relevance
Information for deployers and downstream providers
Enabling human oversight during use period
Resistance to adversarial attacks and unauthorised manipulation
Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment (FRIA) for high-risk AI in public services / border control
Conformity assessment — internal control (Annex VI) for most high-risk
Annex III high-risk — third-party assessment required
Registration of high-risk AI system in EU database
Death of a person — within 10 days after establishing causal link
Downstream provider obligations (substantial modification -> new provider)
Written agreements with downstream providers specifying compliance information

attrs.name: Data at Rest Encryption
attrs.evidence_depth: Enterprise tooling + SOC + continuous audit + external certification
attrs.example_controls: Own HSM-backed managed key custody (FIPS 140-2 Level 3) + dedicated crypto team + strong symmetric encryption at rest across core banking (legacy enterprise database), payment systems, model store, data lake. DORA Art. 9 encryption + Art. 8
attrs.notes: Tier RIGOROUS; risk Financial data (not Art. 9 biometric) but DORA Art. 87 ICT data protection applies. HSM is mandatory for ECB-supervised credit institutions. Strong symmetric encryption baseline satisfies GDPR + CRA + NIS 2 + DORA + AI Act jointly.; priority PARTIAL.
attrs.risk_if_not_met: Financial data (not Art. 9 biometric) but DORA Art. 87 ICT data protection applies. HSM is mandatory for ECB-supervised credit institutions. Strong symmetric encryption baseline satisfies GDPR + CRA + NIS 2 + DORA + AI Act jointly.

attrs.name: Cryptographic Key Management

attrs.notes: Tier RIGOROUS; risk Quarterly key-rotation audit. Key-management policy vetted by external auditor annually. Full key-lineage logging. Annual external certification (FIPS 140-2 + Common Criteria EAL4+).; priority PARTIAL.
attrs.risk_if_not_met: Quarterly key-rotation audit. Key-management policy vetted by external auditor annually. Full key-lineage logging. Annual external certification (FIPS 140-2 + Common Criteria EAL4+).

attrs.name: Data Integrity Mechanisms
attrs.evidence_depth: Enterprise tooling + SOC + continuous audit + external certification
attrs.example_controls: Own HMAC + DB constraints + WORM storage for audit logs + Merkle tree integrity proofs for transaction logs. DORA Art. 9 integrity + Art. 12 ICT change records
attrs.notes: Tier RIGOROUS; risk Immutable audit logs (cryptographic sharding per D-05.3 vs D-10.2 tension resolution). Tamper-evident storage with hash chains.; priority PARTIAL.
attrs.risk_if_not_met: Immutable audit logs (cryptographic sharding per D-05.3 vs D-10.2 tension resolution). Tamper-evident storage with hash chains.

rules_table.title: Personal, financial, and AI data in persistent storage protected by confidentiality mechanisms with segregated cryptographic material management. Apply field-level confidentiality for PII and AI training datasets.
rules_table.source: GDPR-C04, C14; CRA-C07; NIS2-C18; DORA-C09; AI-C17

rules_table.title: Data crossing network boundaries protected by confidentiality mechanisms appropriate to channel classification for internal, external, and API communications. Enforce strict transport security and certificate validation for critical endpoints.
Cryptographic material custody with segregated lifecycle controls (generation, rotation, revocation, destruction). Separate material by data classification and regulatory domain.
Ensure data integrity controls and AI system resilience against manipulation, adversarial attacks, and unauthorized model modification. Implement integrity checksums and model versioning.
